This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Harvest" />

==Biology and appearance==
This diminutive bipedal [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their [[Color|mottled tan]] skin, orange [[hair]], large heads, and big, wideset [[eye]]s.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Species in the galaxy==
By [[4 BBY]],<ref name="Andor Date">{{Andor|One Year Later}} dates the first arc of [[Andor Season 2|''Andor'' 2]] to [[4 BBY]].</ref> at least three members of this species had taken up residence on the [[planet]] [[Mina-Rau]], breaking [[Foodstuff|bread]] with some of the other [[human]]s living there.<ref name="Harvest" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Species-Mina-Rau-Silicone-Bust-Mask.png|right|200px|thumb|One of the silicone bust masks created by Sophie Rechtberger]]
The species made their debut in the [[Harvest|third episode]] of the [[2025]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Ariel Kleiman]].<ref name="Harvest" /> This species was designed by concept artist and sculptor [[Ivan Manzella]],<ref name="Manzella">{{WebCite|url=https://www.krop.com/ivanmanzella|text=Ivan Manzella Creature & Character Designs|author=[[Ivan Manzella|Manzella, Ivan]]|work=[https://www.krop.com Krop]|archivedate=20250715083228}}</ref> while the original silicon bust mask used for this species in the series were modeled by [[Sophie Rechtberger]].<ref name="Rechtberger">{{WebCite|url=http://sophierechtberger.com/silicone-busts-masks|text=SOPHIE RECHTBERGER|work=[http://sophierechtberger.com SOPHIE RECHTBERGER]|archivedate=20250518022123}}</ref>
